title: Daily Notes / Templates 对接
action: Add Daily Notes creation and template variable substitution to ObsidianService

changes: Add createDailyNote(vaultPath, date?, template?): creates YYYY-MM-DD.md in vault's daily notes folder
Add getDailyNote(vaultPath, date?): reads existing daily note for given date
Add appendToDailyNote(vaultPath, date?, content): appends content to daily note, creates if not exists
Add resolveDailyNotesConfig(vaultPath): reads .obsidian/daily-notes.json to find folder + template config
Add applyTemplate(template, variables): replaces {{date}}, {{time}}, {{title}} etc. in template string
Extend IObsidianService with createDailyNote, getDailyNote, appendToDailyNote

estimated_changes: 60 lines to obsidian-service.ts, 10 lines to types.ts, 50 lines to tests
